contents:
Reset your password

Use these steps when you cannot sign in.
1. Open the sign-in page and select Forgot password.
2. Enter the email address of your account.
3. Open the message we send you and select the reset link. The link works for 30 minutes.
4. Choose a new password with at least 12 characters.

Change the email address of your account

1. Open Settings and go to Account.
2. Select Change email and enter the new address.
3. Enter your password to confirm.
We send a confirmation message to the new address. Until you confirm it, the old address stays in use.

The confirmation message does not arrive

A confirmation message can take up to 10 minutes.
- Look in the spam folder of the new address.
- Check that the address is spelled correctly under Settings > Account.
- Select Send again to get a new message. Each message replaces the one before it.

Known issue: dates in an exported file are one day early

Status: under investigation.
When the time zone of your account is ahead of UTC, the dates in an exported file can be one day early.
Workaround: set the time zone to UTC before you export, then set it back.

Feature request: yearly billing

Status: collecting votes.
Plans are billed every month. The Plus plan costs 9 € per month.
Yearly billing is not available. Vote for this request to be told when that changes.

Delete your account

1. Open Settings and go to Account.
2. Select Delete account and enter your password.
Your data is removed after 14 days. Sign in again within that time to keep the account.
